items.subject: Quest Stage: AI Native Super Engineer - MUST Company
items.body:
Good day Faisal,

You have passed the previous stage and will now proceed to the Quest stage.

Please review the attached PDF for full instructions.

To proceed:

Open your Quest (https://matchhire.must.company/quest/8XpPKuTYF7by8fBSON2CGKpnSBeiJkJA) to continue. You will be asked to sign in, then you can Accept to begin (your timer starts when you accept) or Decline to withdraw.

Once accepted, the Quest will begin automatically.

MUST Company Link: https://must.company/
LinkedIn Recruiter Link: https://linkedin.com/in/mouli-chandra8448
Job Link: https://matchhire.must.company/apply/FaWt9SebB2KofAT74rdMmosPuw580uMG

Best regards,
Chandra Mouli
items.draft: Hi Chandra Mouli, noted — you're withdrawn, no further action. Reply if you want back in later. — Team
